'''Albert Russell''' is a [[human]] located along the road west of the [[Northwind Logging Camp]] in [[Northwind]]. He was placed in charge with the maintenance of the lights along the roads of Northwind.

==Quotes==
;Gossip
Sending me out here all on my own just to fix these damned lights - what were they thinking? Once I'm done with this one I'll scurry over to the Honey Drop Inn for an ice cold Amberale.
